title: DD→GC Workshop: 5. Logs
description: Container logs from order-api and payment-svc (Datadog Agent log collection, containerCollectAll). Depends on the 'workshop-access-log-status' log pipeline (see observability/README.md) to remap real HTTP status codes onto log severity — without it, every werkzeug access log line lands as status:error regardless of the actual response code, since Flask's dev server writes access logs to stderr.

definition.content: **Read before trusting `status:error` here:** Flask's built-in dev server writes its access log (every request, any status code) to stderr, and the Datadog Agent defaults stderr lines to `status:error`. The `workshop-access-log-status` pipeline (provisioned alongside this dashboard) remaps severity from the real HTTP status code in the message — but only for logs ingested *after* the pipeline was created. If this dashboard still looks like 100% error rate, the pipeline hasn't caught up yet or wasn't imported; check `observability/README.md`.
